title: Figma ontology for dashboard variant mapping and rollout visual language
creator: Sana Kapoor
description: Goal: Define a compact, machine- and human-readable Figma ontology that captures component variants and interaction states used across the Console dashboards, rollout rails, and cost views. This ticket bundles a prototype Figma library, naming rules for tokens and variants, and a small set of reference pages that demonstrate how rollout states (canary, stable, failed) and cost density charts should visually anchor to the design system. The intent is to reduce ad-hoc variants created by teams and make cross-surface consistency checks automatable via the Figma file and naming conventions.
context: Motivation came from multiple product reviews where rollout rail styles and cost chart micro-interactions were implemented slightly differently across routes (alerts, budgets, model routes). Engineering teams reported inconsistent implementation on the frontend because variant names and token aliases had drifted. This ticket follows the Console component audit in Q4 and aims to standardize: (1) variant naming for interactive states (rest/hover/press/disabled/inline-edit), (2) rollout status visual language (canary/staged/stable/fallback), and (3) density and token scales for compact vs. spacious dashboard canvases.
acceptance_criteria: A Figma library file (read-only production library) exists with a single source-of-truth for: buttons, rails, pills, metric cards, sparkline/cost chart composites, and rollout badges
All components include a clear variant naming convention: <component>/<semantic-role>/<density>/<state> (examples included in figma notes)
Token aliases documented for two density scales (compact, standard) and two color semantics (action/neutral/status) with hex and token references
A 3-screen prototype page showing: dashboard with metric cards, rollout rail showing canary->stable progression, and a cost-view with sparklines and anomaly markers
Design QA checklist (10 items) completed and signed off by PM; includes accessibility contrast checks and focus/keyboard behavior for rollout controls
A short implementation guide (1-page confluence) linked from the Figma file with mapping to frontend classes and a suggested CSS variable map
decisions: Adopt component variant key format: component__role__density__state (double-underscore to avoid conflicting slashes in export tools)
Use 'density' token set with two aliases: density.compact and density.standard; components must expose density as a variant, not a token override
Rollout badge color semantics: canary = amber-500, staged = blue-500, stable = green-600, degraded = red-600
Micro-interaction guidelines: sparklines show hover-temporal tooltip at 8px from pointer; focus outlines must always use token focus.outline to match a11y standards
attachments: GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4382 (implementation stub for rollout-badge component)
